en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town street lined with trees, showing a prominent historic building with a tall clock‑tower-like structure and ornate roof, likely a post office, and a church spire in the background. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk in front of the building. Printed captions in German identify the location as Bad Elster and reference the imperial post office and the publisher.
